components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard action button for confirmations, checkouts, and main steps.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">ดำเนินการต่อ</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1363eb; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 16px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--font-noto-thai), sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #004dcb; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supports cancel, back, and optional actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #f1f3f5; color: #617285; padding: 10px 16px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid #dbe0e6; border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--font-noto-thai), sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e2e6ea; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Indicates status in high-contrast but muted transparent background tags.
components.html: พร้อมยืม
components.css: .ds-status-chip { padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-noto-thai), sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-status-success { background: rgba(21, 131, 60, 0.1); color: #15833c; border: 1px solid rgba(21, 131, 60, 0.2); }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: Standard input field with focus feedback.
components.html: <input type="text" class="ds-form-input" placeholder="รหัสนักศึกษา" />
components.css: .ds-form-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #dbe0e6; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: #12161a; font-family: var(--font-noto-thai), sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-form-input:focus { border-color: #1363eb; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(19, 99, 235, 0.2); }

narrative.overview: The BCTL Inventory visual system prioritizes clarity, low cognitive load, and high functional reliability. Designed for BUCA Talent staff and students managing physical media equipment, the interface serves physical, focused operations. Spacing is rhythmic, density is high to support reading tabular logs, and visual distractions are minimized.
keyCharacteristics: High-density information presentation with clean borders.
Structured, predictable layout hierarchy (desktop top bar and side navigation).
State-rich semantic vocabulary (hover, active, warning, success) using solid background tints.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: The primary accent is used on <=10% of any given screen. Saturated colors represent interactive capability or state changes only, not decoration.

rules.name: The Muted State Rule
rules.body: Non-interactive elements and background highlights must utilize transparent tints (success/10, destructive/10) to preserve visual calm.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: All layouts, cards, and tables are flat at rest. Drop shadows are prohibited for static decoration.

dos: Do align tables and lists to consistent typographic columns with 1px border dividers.
Do use semantic transparent background colors (e.g. bg-success/10 text-success) to mark status indicators.
Do ensure all clickable items have a visible focus ring (focus-ring) for accessibility.
Do maintain a consistent 8px/16px rounding system throughout the interface.
Do perform verification checks via the secure /api/auth/check-student server endpoint to avoid client RLS blocks.
Do pre-fill verified inputs (email, phone) in registration forms to reduce user friction.
donts: Don't use cluttered dashboard layouts with overwhelming metrics or distracting flashy gradients.
Don't use excessive nested cards; nested cards are prohibited.
Don't use side-stripe borders (e.g. border-left > 1px as a colored stripe on cards, alerts, or list items).
Don't use gradient text (e.g. background-clip: text combined with a gradient background).
Don't redirect to registration if the email already exists in the system but the phone number is incorrect.
Don't run database lookups directly from client-side handlers on RLS-protected tables.
